caption:
A full calendar feels like proof your marketing works.

It isn't.

Pull your last 30 jobs. Sort by lead source and profit margin, not by how busy they kept you.

The same pattern shows up again and again: the leads that fill the calendar fastest pay the least.

Cheap, urgent calls get answered first because they're the easy yes. Higher-value jobs need a few qualifying questions, so they sit in voicemail while a competitor grabs them first.

Ask budget, timeline, and scope before the calendar opens. A quiz funnel does this automatically, before a lead ever reaches your schedule.
